we identified a testicular cell subpopulation, the side-scattered subpopulation of cells (or side population, SP), which represents a fraction of germinal cells and which might represent a sub-population of germinal stem cells in chicken testis.
we have identified four testicular cell subgroups based on the nuclear DNA content and the expression of two specific genes, Dazl and/or Stra8.

the characterization of the testicular cell populations of the male germ cell compartment.
the development of a method for the isolation of chicken spermatogonial stem cells, which can be used in the development of transgenic chicken lines.
the development of a simple, rapid and reliable method to obtain a pure population of stem spermatogonial cells in cockerels.

the side scatter subpopulation of testis cells (SP) is a subpopulation enriched in germ cells, and this population can be isolated by FACS.
